title: Circular No. (10/6 /3271) dated 26/2/2019 about ATM instructions.
text:
Number: 10/6 /3271
Date: 21/6/1440 Hijri
Corresponding to 26/2/2019
Circular to licensed banks
After Greetings,
In light of the feedback related to the Automated Teller Machine
Instructions No. (6/2018) dated 11/4/2018 pursuant to our Circular No.
(10/6/13716) dated 21/10/2018 in this regard. it was decided to make the
following amendments to the aforementioned instructions:
First: Amend Paragraph (3) of Article (4 / A) to read: Provide two network
lines for an ATM from different providers, wherever possible.
Second: Amending Paragraph (6) of Article (4 / A) so that it becomes:
Installing a satellite tracking chip (Global Positioning System chip)
inside ATMs installed in public places and outside the branch buildings,
enabling them to locate the device exposed to the risks of being
removed, so that the tracking device is installed in a safe place inside
the ATM that is difficult to be accessed.
Third: Amending Paragraph (8) of Article (4 / A) so that it becomes: store the
images captured by ATM surveillance cameras for periods of time and
according to the periods stipulated in our instructions in this regard.
Fourth: Amending Paragraph (I) of Article (5) so that it becomes: To meet the
specifications of ATMs Safe so that they align with the (CEN1)
standard at the minimum, or any equivalent internationally accepted
standards in this regard, and the payment service provider is obligated
to reconcile their status in compliance with this clause within a period
of three years from the date of issuance of these instructions.

Fifth: Amend Paragraph (a) of Article (10) so that it becomes: Immediately
inform his customer about the financial transaction that have been
executed on his accounts using ATMs, using an effective and clear
communication method in one of the Arabic or English languages such
as SMS, provided that it includes at least the place, date and time of the
transaction, its value and the type of currency.
Sixth: Amend Article (15) so that it becomes: Payment service providers are
obligated to adjust the status of their ATMs within (18) month from the
date of issuing these instructions, taking into consideration Article (5 /
I) of these instructions.
Respectfully,,
Governor
Dr. Ziad Fariz
